elements.name: Main title
elements.description: Top-level screen title that Custom Code may replace.

elements.name: Hardware summary
elements.description: Compact LVGL, touch, display, and expander summary below the sine gauge.

elements.name: Last touch status
elements.description: Shows the latest GT911 interaction and touch coordinates.

elements.name: Pause toggle button
elements.description: Each click toggles the retained pause command. Keep the waveshare43_example:: namespace on every bridge call. Use waveshare43_example::take_touch_button_click() for a one-loop pulse or waveshare43_example::take_pause_state_change() to detect only state changes. A true pause state means Visuino should stop the sine flow; invert it when wiring to an Enabled input.

elements.name: Pause state and click counter
elements.description: Visible running/paused state and count of successful pause-button click events.

elements.name: Sine speed slider
elements.description: 0-100 speed command for Visuino. The waveshare43_example:: namespace is required because it tells C++ where the bridge function lives. AValue is the integer received by the Visuino Input. Use waveshare43_example::take_test_slider_change() when only user changes should emit.

elements.name: Slider value
elements.description: Text representation of the current 0-100 sine-speed command.

elements.name: Sine output gauge
elements.description: Speedometer-style LVGL meter for the 0-100 sine-wave value generated in Visuino. Use one waveshare43_example::set_sine_gauge_value(AValue); Input call. It updates the needle and percentage label together; no loop output or second label input is required.

elements.name: Sine gauge value
elements.description: Internal numeric text linked to the sine gauge. Do not create a separate Visuino Input for this label; the gauge setter updates the needle and this label together.
